name: vitruvian-roborock
description: Check on and control a Roborock vacuum: status, live map, start, pause, dock and mop wash.

args: command -v rrctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "vitruvian-roborock: rrctl is not on your PATH. Install it: https://github.com/VitruvianSoftware/mcp-roborock#quick-installation" >&2; exit 127; }; case "$(rrctl --version 2>/dev/null)" in *"(rust)"*) exec rrctl mcp ;; esac; echo "vitruvian-roborock: the rrctl on your PATH is the old Python tool. Run rrctl daemon stop, then uv tool uninstall vitruvian-roborock, install the Rust rrctl (https://github.com/VitruvianSoftware/mcp-roborock#quick-installation) and restart this session." >&2; exit 1
